chunks: When your Lord said to the angels, 'Indeed, I am going to create a man from clay.'
ai.seo_question: What did Allah tell the angels about creating man?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse marks the commencement of the cosmic narrative of creation, emphasizing Allah's sovereign will in choosing clay as the primordial substance for Adam. It sets the stage for the subsequent dialogue with the angels, highlighting the unique status of humanity as Allah's vicegerent (Khalifah) on earth.
